Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root before suggesting changes.
It carries the stack, the commands, where things live, and the rules that hold
everywhere — none of which are specific to any one assistant.

Workflows for adding a resource, a role, an admin screen, an upload or an email
are in [.agents/niftic-app/GUIDE.md](../.agents/niftic-app/GUIDE.md).

This file exists because Copilot looks for this path and does not read
`AGENTS.md`. It deliberately contains no rules of its own.
